mapper.select: SELECT e.*, s.school_name AS school_name, g.grade_name AS grade_name, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM exam_subject es WHERE es.exam_id = e.id AND es.deleted = 0) AS subject_count FROM exam e LEFT JOIN school s ON s.id = e.school_id LEFT JOIN grade g ON g.id = e.grade_id WHERE e.id = #{id} AND e.deleted = 0
